scenes.description: Neon city lights slide across the windshield as a car glides through an empty boulevard at night.

shot.composition: car centered on the lower third, light streaks on both sides
shot.subject_action: the car glides forward, the driver's silhouette visible through the glass

scenes.description: Close on the young man's face behind the wheel; reflections of neon pass over his eyes.

shot.lighting: neon rim light from the side window
shot.composition: face on the right third, bokeh city lights left
shot.subject_action: he glances at the rear-view mirror and half-smiles

scenes.description: He parks, takes the bottle from the console and sprays it once at his neck.

shot.lighting: warm interior light against cool neon
shot.composition: hands and bottle in the foreground, face soft in the background
shot.subject_action: his hand lifts the bottle and sprays once

scenes.description: Hero shot: the bottle stands on the dark car roof, a party glowing behind it.

shot.composition: bottle centered, label facing camera, party lights bokeh behind
shot.subject_action: the camera orbits slowly around the bottle
shot.setting: car roof outside a rooftop party
